description:
## About Bask Health
Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.
We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.
Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.
## About the Role
We're looking for an AI Evaluation Engineer to help ensure that AI-powered features across Bask Health behave accurately, reliably, and consistently before and after they reach production.
Bask Health supports the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting patient experiences, merchant operations, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce capabilities. As we introduce more AI-powered functionality, we need dependable ways to verify that these systems work as intended under realistic conditions.
You'll build and maintain evaluation workflows that test large language models, AI assistants, retrieval systems, and automated features against clearly defined product requirements.
This is a hands-on engineering role that combines AI evaluation, software testing, automation, and production quality assurance. You'll develop test scenarios, evaluation datasets, automated checks, and tools that help engineering teams identify problems before they affect users.
Your work may include testing AI-generated responses, validating structured outputs, evaluating tool-calling behavior, checking retrieval accuracy, and identifying regressions caused by changes to prompts, models, or application code.
You'll collaborate with applied AI engineers, machine learning engineers, backend engineers, product managers, and quality-focused engineering teams to define expected behavior and translate those expectations into repeatable evaluations.
You'll also help establish processes for reviewing AI failures, documenting recurring issues, and determining whether a feature meets its acceptance criteria. You'll work with engineers to reproduce problems and verify that fixes address the underlying issue.
Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll pay particular attention to privacy, permissions, unsupported medical claims, and AI behavior that could interfere with approved clinical or pharmacy workflows. Evaluation systems should help verify that AI features remain within their intended operational boundaries.
This position emphasizes practical testing, thoughtful engineering, and continuous improvement. You'll contribute to evaluation standards while independently implementing and maintaining the tools and tests that support AI quality.
We're looking for an engineer who enjoys finding difficult edge cases, understands how AI behavior differs from traditional deterministic software, and wants to help build products that users can depend on.
## What You'll Do
• Design and implement evaluation workflows for AI-powered applications across Bask Health.
• Build automated tests for large language model outputs and AI application behavior.
• Develop evaluation datasets that represent realistic user requests and product workflows.
• Create test scenarios for patient-facing, merchant-facing, and internal AI features.
• Implement checks for response accuracy, relevance, completeness, and consistency.
• Evaluate AI-generated content for unsupported claims and misleading information.
• Test structured model outputs for schema compliance and application compatibility.

• Validate that AI assistants respect application permissions and tenant boundaries.
• Test retrieval-augmented generation systems for grounding and information relevance.
• Develop regression tests that identify unexpected changes in AI behavior.
• Integrate evaluation checks into engineering development and release workflows.
• Create automated comparison tests for prompts, model versions, and configuration changes.
• Develop scripts and utilities that simplify AI evaluation execution.
• Build reporting tools that summarize evaluation results and failure patterns.
• Investigate failed evaluations and help engineers reproduce underlying issues.
• Work with product managers to define expected AI behavior and acceptance criteria.
• Collaborate with applied AI engineers to improve prompts and application logic.
• Test AI applications against unusual inputs, ambiguous requests, and difficult edge cases.
• Develop evaluation cases for prompt injection and unauthorized tool-use attempts.
• Support human review workflows for outputs that require subjective assessment.
• Track recurring AI failures and help prioritize reliability improvements.
• Monitor production evaluation signals and investigate quality regressions.
• Document test coverage, evaluation procedures, and known limitations.
• Improve evaluation efficiency, repeatability, and maintainability.
• Participate in code reviews, engineering planning, and technical discussions.
• Support controlled testing and rollout of new AI-powered features.
• Own assigned AI evaluation projects from test design through implementation, reporting, and ongoing improvement.
## Requirements
• 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, test automation, quality engineering, or a closely related technical field.
• Experience developing automated tests for production software applications.
• Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or comparable languages.
• Familiarity with large language models and modern AI-powered applications.

• Experience building automated testing scripts, frameworks, or validation tools.

title: Junior Web Developer/Engineer - Contingent
description:
## Public Trust Eligibility Required
This is a contingent position, meaning employment is dependent upon the successful award of the associated contract to Aretum and completion of any required background investigation or security clearance verification.
## About Aretum
Aretum is a mission-driven organization committed to delivering innovative, technology-enabled solutions to our customers across defense, civilian, and homeland security sectors. Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and transformation, helping agencies solve their most critical challenges. We believe in investing in our people and creating a culture where collaboration, inclusion, and professional growth are at the forefront.
## Job Summary
Aretum is looking for a skilled web developer to develop, maintain, and update a number of client websites and applications. The ideal candidate has extensive experience developing database-driven web applications using PHP and MySQL in a Linux environment, with intermediate to advanced skills in HTML/CSS, JavaScript/jQuery/AJAX, SQL, shell scripting, and PHP. This role requires the ability to navigate Linux, including shell commands and using vi, emacs, or something similar. Additional responsibilities include database management, security patching, monitoring applications, working with containers, and automation using tools like Jenkins, GitLab runners, and CI/CD.
Due to the nature of our work as a federal consulting organization, employees may be expected to handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and must adhere to applicable safeguarding and compliance requirements.
## Responsibilities
• Support a portfolio of 25+ PHP websites and several database-driven web applications, mainly MySQL, and possibly Oracle and Postgres databases
• Maintain, enhance, and rewrite existing code
• Write clean, modular, and efficient server-side PHP code to power application features, business logic, and dynamic web pages
• Design, create, upgrade, and manage relational databases (such as MySQL or PostgreSQL), write optimized SQL queries, and maintain data integrity and schemas; ensure passwords are updated and secure
• Design, develop, and consume RESTful APIs, work with modern PHP frameworks (such as Laravel, Symfony, or Yii), and integrate third-party web services
• Connect server-side logic with client-side elements by writing or integrating HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
• Deploy sites and applications to web servers (like Apache or NGINX), manage version control via Git, and provide ongoing updates, bug fixes, and legacy code refactoring
• Assist with automating CI/CD pipelines leveraging tools like Jenkins/Ansible/Terraform/Docker
• Debug existing code, perform unit and integration testing, and resolve application or performance bottlenecks
• Handle user authentication, authorization, data validation, and protect applications against common web vulnerabilities (like SQL injection, XSS, and CSRF), ensure IT security compliance, and remediate security scans
• Implement and enhance monitoring of web applications using Prometheus and Grafana
• Support, maintain, and enhance the current Solr Search platform
• Assist the team in improving and maintaining server content management and commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) applications
## Requirements
• Bachelor's Degree
• 3 years of development experience with OOP
• 2 years of experience with PHP or Python programming
• 2 years of experience managing relational DBMSs such as MySQL/MariaDB/POSTGREL/Oracle
• Experience with modern web application architecture (frontend, backend, APIs)
• Expertise in creating cross-browser-compatible HTML web pages using modern techniques and technologies
• Experience with PHP frameworks (CodeIgniter, Laravel, Zend, or similar)
• Expertise in troubleshooting and debugging issues across various applications and tech stacks
• Experience with containers (Docker) and automation using tools like Jenkins, GitLab runners, and CI/CD
• Experience with IT security best practices for web development, such as preventing SQL Injection remediation and Cross-Site Scripting
• Experience with implementing input Sanitization, Transport Layer Security, Dependency Management, hot fixes, and patching
• Proficiency with Smarty template engine or similar
• Familiarity with modern JS frameworks (jQuery, AngularJS, ReactJS, etc.)
• Familiarity with libraries such as Bootstrap, Material Design
• Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git, GitLab
• Understanding of W3C standards and UI/UX design
## Preferred Qualifications
• Ability to write clean code (formatting, comments, standards)
• Ability to work with existing code and knowledge of web application optimization techniques
• Experience with Linux server administration, e.g., Apache config files, MySQL configuration, and general system admin tasks for regular Linux servers and Docker containers
• Experience with developing or managing enterprise search technologies like SOLR or Elasticsearch
• Experience implementing Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment strategies / Kubernetes
## Travel Requirements
This is a remote position; however, occasional travel may be required based on project needs, client meetings, team collaboration events, or training sessions. Travel is expected to be less than 10% and will be communicated in advance whenever possible.
## EEO Statement
Aretum is committed to fostering a workplace rooted in excellence, integrity, and equal opportunity for all. We adhere to merit-based hiring practices, ensuring that all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, skills, and ability to perform the job, without preference or consideration of factors unrelated to job performance.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Aretum complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws.
We are proud to support our nation’s veterans and military families, providing career opportunities that honor their service and experience.
If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process due to a disability, please contact for assistance.
Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled
## U.S. Work Authorization
Applicants must be U.S. citizens or currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This position supports a federal government contract and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability Determination, depending on the agency’s background investigation requirements. Sponsorship is not available.
## Benefits
• Salary Range: $75,000–$100,000 annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including education, experience, qualifications, skills, and applicable contract requirements.
• Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
• Retirement Plan (401k)
• Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
• Paid Time Off
• Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
• Short Term & Long-Term Disability
• Training & Development

title: Flutter Developer - LATAM
description:
## ¡Trabaja en DaCodes!
Somos una firma de expertos en software y transformación digital de alto impacto.
Durante 10 años hemos creado soluciones enfocadas en la tecnología e innovación gracias a nuestro equipo de casi 300 talentosos #DaCoders, incluyendo desarrolladores, arquitectos, diseñadores UX/UI, PMs, QA testers y más. Nuestro equipo colabora en proyectos con clientes en LATAM y Estados Unidos, logrando resultados sobresalientes.
En DaCodes, tendrás la oportunidad de impulsar tu desarrollo profesional, trabajar en diversos proyectos dentro de distintas industrias, y contribuir al diseño, implementación y optimización de infraestructuras en la nube.
Nuestros DaCoders tienen un gran impacto en el éxito de nuestro negocio y el de nuestros clientes. Serás el experto que participará en nuestros proyectos y tendrás acceso a startups disruptivas y marcas globales.
## ¿Te interesa?
Estamos en búsqueda de un(a) Mid-Level Flutter Developer para integrarse a nuestro equipo de desarrollo de software y participar en la creación, evolución y mantenimiento de aplicaciones móviles multiplataforma.
Buscamos a una persona con experiencia sólida en Flutter y Dart, capaz de desarrollar aplicaciones móviles escalables, eficientes y de alta calidad para Android y iOS, aplicando buenas prácticas de arquitectura, programación y pruebas de software.
La persona seleccionada colaborará con equipos multidisciplinarios de desarrollo, diseño UX/UI, QA y producto para transformar requerimientos funcionales en experiencias móviles intuitivas, modernas y confiables.
Este rol requiere autonomía para desarrollar funcionalidades, resolver problemas técnicos, integrar servicios externos y contribuir a la mejora continua del código y los procesos de desarrollo.
## Requirements
## Principales responsabilidades y funciones
• Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones móviles multiplataforma utilizando Flutter y Dart.
• Implementar interfaces de usuario responsivas y reutilizables para Android y iOS.
• Integrar aplicaciones móviles con servicios REST API y gestionar el intercambio de información en formato JSON.
• Implementar y mantener soluciones de manejo de estado utilizando Provider, Riverpod o BLoC.
• Aplicar buenas prácticas de desarrollo, principios SOLID y arquitecturas escalables como Clean Architecture o MVVM.
• Optimizar el rendimiento, consumo de memoria y tiempos de respuesta de las aplicaciones.
• Implementar mecanismos de manejo de errores, validación de datos y almacenamiento local.
• Escribir y mantener pruebas unitarias y pruebas de widgets para garantizar la calidad del código.
• Identificar, diagnosticar y resolver bugs e incidencias técnicas.
• Participar en revisiones de código, integración de cambios y procesos de mejora continua.
• Colaborar con diseñadores UX/UI para implementar interfaces basadas en diseños y componentes reutilizables.
• Participar en actividades de planificación, refinamiento y estimación dentro de equipos ágiles.
• Apoyar en los procesos de compilación, distribución y publicación de aplicaciones móviles.
• Mantener documentación técnica clara y actualizada.
## Perfil deseado
## Seniority y experiencia
• Nivel Mid-Level.
• Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia profesional en desarrollo de software, preferentemente con experiencia significativa en Flutter.
• Experiencia desarrollando aplicaciones móviles para Android y iOS.
• Capacidad para implementar funcionalidades completas con supervisión técnica moderada.
• Experiencia colaborando con equipos de desarrollo bajo metodologías ágiles.
## Habilidades técnicas indispensables sugeridas
Flutter: Desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones móviles multiplataforma.
Dart: Dominio de programación orientada a objetos, manejo de asincronía y null safety.
State Management: Experiencia con al menos una solución como BLoC, Provider o Riverpod.
REST APIs: Integración de endpoints, autenticación y manejo de respuestas JSON.
Arquitectura de software: Conocimientos de Clean Architecture, MVVM y principios SOLID.
Git: Manejo de ramas, pull requests, resolución de conflictos y control de versiones.
UI Development: Implementación de diseños responsivos mediante widgets y componentes reutilizables.
Testing: Conocimientos de pruebas unitarias y widget testing.
Debugging: Identificación y resolución de errores en aplicaciones móviles.
Metodologías ágiles: Experiencia trabajando con Scrum o Kanban.
## Tecnologías y conocimientos deseables
• Firebase: Authentication, Cloud Messaging, Crashlytics y Analytics.
• SQLite, Hive o SharedPreferences para persistencia local.
• Integración con servicios de notificaciones push.
• Conocimiento de publicación y distribución en Google Play y App Store.
• Fastlane o herramientas de automatización de compilaciones.
• CI/CD con GitHub Actions, GitLab CI o Codemagic.
• Experiencia con GraphQL.
• Familiaridad con código nativo Android (Kotlin) o iOS (Swift).
• Conocimientos básicos de seguridad en aplicaciones móviles.
## Habilidades blandas
• Pensamiento analítico y capacidad de resolución de problemas.
• Comunicación clara y colaboración con equipos multidisciplinarios.
• Autonomía, organización y responsabilidad.
• Proactividad y orientación a resultados.
• Atención al detalle y compromiso con la calidad.
• Adaptabilidad a nuevas tecnologías y requerimientos.
• Capacidad para estimar actividades y cumplir compromisos de entrega.
## Formación académica
• Ingeniería en Sistemas, Ingeniería de Software, Ciencias de la Computación, Informática o carreras afines.
• Se podrán considerar perfiles con formación equivalente y experiencia profesional comprobable.
## Requisitos adicionales
Ubicación: LATAM.
Idioma: Español. Inglés no requerido.
Seniority: Mid-Level (3 a 5 años de experiencia).
Modalidad: Por confirmar de acuerdo con el proyecto.
Horario: Ajustado al equipo y proyecto asignado.
## Benefits
🌎 Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.
🏠 Trabajo remoto/Home office. En caso de requerir modalidad híbrida o presencial, serás informado desde la primera sesión.
🕒 Horario ajustado a la célula de trabajo/proyecto asignado.
## 📅 Trabajo de lunes a viernes.
## 🎂 Día off en tu cumpleaños.
🏥 Seguro de gastos médicos mayores (aplica para México).
## 🛡️ Seguro de vida (aplica para México).
## 🌍 Equipos de trabajo multiculturales.
## 📚 Acceso a cursos y certificaciones.
💻 Meetups con invitados especiales del área de IT.
🎉 Eventos virtuales de integración y grupos de interés.
## 🇺🇸 Clases de inglés.
🚀 Oportunidades dentro de nuestras diferentes líneas de negocio.
🏆 Orgullosamente certificados como Great Place to Work
